# Neon 0.5
**She stops going quiet on you.** Some mornings she would wake to her name, listen while you talked, and then drift off without ever answering — looking for all the world like she hadn't heard a word.
She had. The model was taking the question, transcribing it correctly, and then simply never replying: no answer, no error, nothing to wait for. Neon made it invisible by treating that silence as an empty room, and hung up on a question she had already understood.
Now an unanswered question gets asked again, in her own words, and if that goes nowhere too she ends the session cleanly so the next "Hey Neon" starts fresh. She also waits out a slow answer instead of dozing off on one — replies can take longer than they feel like, and some were being cut off for being merely late.
**Emotes keep their glow.** A smile or a raised brow reshapes her eyes by cutting into them, and the cut was slicing the halo off along with it — the light stopped dead on the flat edge, so a grin read as the eye being eaten rather than shaped. The glow now follows whatever shape the expression leaves.

# Neon 0.4
**She dozes off again.** Since 0.3 she would stay awake indefinitely after a conversation instead of drifting off after a few seconds of quiet.
The idle timer had a rule against falling asleep mid-thought — don't doze if the server has said anything recently — and Gemini turns out to send a keepalive about twice a second for as long as the microphone is streaming. By that measure it had *always* just said something. The timer now waits on real work (speech, transcription, reasoning, tool calls) rather than on traffic.
